result:
Nothing in the ledger is due for review yet. The earliest Revisit date is 2 Dec 2026 (bake-to-order).

**Not suggesting a free trial.** You dropped the free first box on 6 Oct 2026. Only 6 of 52 people converted, and the free boxes used Saturday slots that paying customers wanted. You'd reopen it only if paid signups fall below 8 a month for 2 months in a row. October had 15, so that hasn't happened.

Here are three ideas that don't conflict with the ledger:

1. **Half-price first month, but only through a current subscriber.** Each of your 140 subscribers gets a code to give one friend 50% off their first month. You dropped 50% off on its own because you expected it to attract the same people as the free box. But your reopen condition for it was exactly this: test it through a referral. A friend's recommendation brings people who are more likely to stay. Run it for 6 weeks and compare how many stay on after the first month with the free-box 6 out of 52.

2. **Paid one-off taster box, not on Saturday.** Sell a single €18 box with no subscription, collected at the shop on Friday afternoon. It's still baked to order with the 6 pm cutoff. People get to try you without committing, you don't lose money on it, and it doesn't use your Saturday delivery slots. Put a card in the box with a "subscribe this week, skip the first delivery fee" offer, or just a sign-up QR code.

3. **Target the streets you already ride.** Spend about €100 to €150 of the monthly budget on flyers for buildings and streets next to your current subscribers, with a line like "Your neighbour at No. 12 gets theirs on Saturday." New subscribers on existing routes cost almost no extra delivery time. That matters because Saturday capacity is what limits you. Ask a few subscribers if you can mention their street.

If you choose one, tell me and I'll log it. I'd start with #1, because it's also the test your ledger already says to run.
prompt: Our signups are flat. Give me 3 ideas to get more people to try us.
